description: This header defines macros for transforming variadic macro arguments into repeated macro invocations, including concatenation and argument counting, used internally in the Abseil C++ library.

methods.name: ABSL_INTERNAL_CAT
methods.description: Concatenates two macro arguments into a single token.

methods.name: ABSL_INTERNAL_TRANSFORM_ARGS
methods.description: Transforms a macro and a list of arguments into repeated macro invocations, handling up to 32 arguments.
